name: How can I reduce property insurance costs for my Florida investment property?

mainEntity.name: How can I reduce property insurance costs for my Florida investment property?

acceptedAnswer.text: To reduce property insurance costs for your Florida investment property, consider investing in wind mitigation improvements like impact-resistant windows or a newer, hurricane-rated roof. Shopping around for quotes from multiple insurers and raising your deductible can also lower premiums. It's also beneficial to maintain a good claims history. We often recommend obtaining detailed wind mitigation reports and reviewing them with an insurance agent to identify the most cost-effective upgrades before finalizing a purchase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Reduce costs by investing in wind mitigation, shopping for quotes, raising deductibles, and maintaining a good claims history.
